name: Sable Precision Works Void Projector VP-2 'Event Horizon'
description:
A gravitational compression weapon that creates a micro-singularity approximately 3mm in diameter at a designated point within range. The singularity exists for 0.8 seconds before collapsing, but during that time it exerts gravitational force sufficient to draw in and compress matter within a 2-meter radius.

Sable Precision Works developed the Event Horizon as a proof-of-concept for gravitational manipulation technology. The VP-2 is not a mass-produced weapon — fewer than twelve units exist, each hand-built and individually calibrated. The micro-singularity it produces is not a true black hole, but a localized gravitational anomaly created by manipulating exotic matter held in a magnetic containment field within the weapon.

The Event Horizon's effect is visually striking and physically absolute. Matter drawn toward the micro-singularity is compressed beyond recognition, and the brief gravitational pulse leaves a spherical void approximately 2 meters in diameter where solid matter used to exist. When the singularity collapses, it releases a burst of Hawking-analogue radiation that renders the area temporarily hazardous.
legality: Prohibited — classified as existential-risk weapon system
specifications:
caliber: N/A — projected micro-singularity
effective_range: 10-80 meters
rate_of_fire: 1 singularity per 60 seconds (containment field regeneration)
capacity: 3 singularities per exotic matter cartridge
weight: 28 kg weapon, 18 kg containment/power system
power_source: Exotic matter cartridge, non-rechargeable
tactical_use: The Event Horizon is not a tactical weapon — it is a strategic one. Its micro-singularity defeats any known defensive technology by exploiting a fundamental force that cannot be blocked or deflected. The weapon is deployed against targets of absolute priority — hardened command bunkers, critical infrastructure, and individuals whose elimination justifies the deployment of existential-risk technology. The 60-second regeneration time and limited ammunition make each shot a significant decision.
cultural_context: The VP-2's existence is a closely-guarded secret, but rumors of a gravitational weapon have circulated in GLMZ's intelligence community for years. The spherical voids left by Event Horizon engagements have been attributed to everything from industrial accidents to alien technology. Sable Precision Works' public profile as a boutique firearms manufacturer provides no indication that they are capable of producing gravitational weapons — which is precisely the point.
known_users: Classified — knowledge of VP-2 operators is restricted
story_hooks: A perfect spherical void appeared in the middle of a Tier 4 office building overnight. Everything within the sphere — walls, furniture, three people who were working late — simply ceased to exist. There is no debris and no explanation. Only twelve people in GLMZ know what caused it.

Sable Precision Works' exotic matter supplier has gone dark. Without fresh cartridges, the existing VP-2 units will become inert. Someone is trying to ensure that the Event Horizon can never be fired again — or they are stockpiling exotic matter for their own use.
related_entities: Tessera Industries Void Grenade VG-1 'Black Hole'

physical_description.visual_profile: A deliberately asymmetrical weapon resembling a hybrid between a directed-energy cannon and a containment apparatus. The barrel assembly is visibly oversized relative to the body, flared and ribbed to accommodate the exotic matter projection mechanism. The overall silhouette suggests precision engineering married to controlled instability — elegant but purposefully intimidating.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length: 94 cm. Barrel assembly: 38 cm. Width at containment housing: 18 cm. Height from grip to top rail: 26 cm.
physical_description.weight_description: Severely hefty — the weapon feels like it anchors itself, demanding two-handed control and suggesting the presence of dense internal systems. The weight distribution leans forward toward the barrel assembly, creating a muzzle-heavy balance that requires deliberate aim.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade titanium frame with reinforced carbon-composite barrel housing and exotic-matter magnetic containment core. The containment chamber is housed in a transparent polycarbonate cylinder to allow visual monitoring of the exotic matter state.
physical_description.finish: Brushed titanium with deep matte black polymer grip panels. The containment cylinder is clear polycarbonate with faint iridescent micro-etching that shifts under different angles of light. Heat-dissipation fins are left bare steel, deliberately showing oxidation patina.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal titanium primary, accented with deep matte black. The exotic matter cartridge visible inside the containment cylinder glows with faint violet-white luminescence — the only source of active illumination on the weapon.
physical_description.grip_texture: Deeply textured composite grip with micro-teeth pattern to ensure purchase even under recoil stress. The rear of the grip transitions into brushed bare titanium, deliberately cold and smooth to offset the textured forward grip.
distinctive_features: Transparent containment cylinder running the length of the barrel assembly, displaying the exotic matter cartridge in a state of controlled magnetic suspension
Flared, ribbed barrel opening approximately 12cm in diameter, with internal scoring visible suggesting gravitational field manipulation geometry
Dual lateral heat-dissipation fins along the barrel housing, showing stress fractures and heat discoloration from previous use
Large circular aiming system mounted on top rail — not traditional optics, but a gravitational field intensity gauge with LED cascade indicating charge state
Pressure-release valve beneath the containment housing with a subtle hiss of electromagnetic stabilization audible during operation
Hand-etched serial number on the receiver (each VP-2 is individually numbered 01-12)
Subtle Φ currency symbol etched into the rear grip as manufacturing signature from Sable Precision Works
Faint scorch marks and micro-fractures around the muzzle assembly from exotic matter projection stress
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: "SABLE PRECISION WORKS" stamped in angular, minimalist lettering across the left side of the containment housing. Below it: "VOID PROJECTOR VP-2 PROTOTYPE" with individual unit number. A small certification stamp on the right side reads "EXOTIC MATTER CLASS-X" with a miniature radiation-hazard symbol beside it.
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-maintained but visibly used. The weapon bears the marks of a tool deployed in high-stakes scenarios — the barrel assembly shows heat stress and micro-fracturing, the grip shows wear from intensive handling, and the containment cylinder is scuffed from field transport. However, the internal systems are meticulously preserved; any user capable of wielding this weapon understands its irreplaceable nature.

image_prompt: Product photography of the Sable Precision Works Void Projector VP-2 'Event Horizon' — a 94cm gravitational compression weapon with brushed titanium frame and deep matte black composite grip. The weapon rests horizontally on a dark obsidian-black surface or is cradled in a gloved augmented hand. The transparent polycarbonate containment cylinder runs the length of the barrel assembly, revealing an exotic matter cartridge suspended in violet-white magnetic luminescence. The barrel's flared, ribbed opening dominates the frame, with visible internal scoring suggesting gravitational field manipulation geometry. Dramatic side-lighting from cool-toned LED sources illuminates the brushed titanium surfaces and casts deep shadows across the heat-dissipation fins, which show oxidized stress marks and fracturing. The weapon's asymmetrical, purpose-built design is emphasized by stark shadows and highlights. Neo-noir urban aesthetic: the violet glow of the exotic matter provides the only warm light source, contrasting sharply with cool tungsten and blue LED ambient lighting. Background: neutral dark grey with barely-visible tactical grid overlay. Ultra-sharp focus on the containment cylinder and aiming gauge. --ar 3:2 --v 6
